heart100.title: Heart-100

rows.group: Linear terms present in every seed, same direction

rows.name: Age, female (vs male), typical angina, non-anginal pain, cholesterol, maximum heart rate, flat ST slope, vessels coloured, thallium reversible defect

rows.name: Atypical angina
ST depression
Downsloping ST slope
Thallium not recorded
Thallium fixed defect
Resting blood pressure
Fasting sugar above 120
ECG LV hypertrophy
Exercise angina
ECG ST-T abnormality

rows.group: Non-linear units, by family (the inputs that switch the unit on or off)

rows.name: \textbf{Thallium-scan gate}: a scan defect read through a gate, mostly with ST depression
\textbf{Maximum-heart-rate bend}: a bend or gate in peak heart rate
\textbf{Resting blood pressure}: a threshold, alone or with slope, heart rate, angina or scan
\textbf{Exercise angina}: a gate, read with sex in some seeds (for women in one)
\textbf{Age brake}: risk stops rising, or falls back, past an age
\textbf{ST-depression threshold}: counted only past a threshold
\textbf{Flat ST segment step}: a step, read with chest pain or cholesterol
\textbf{Resting-ECG gate}: the resting ECG through a switching unit
\textbf{Thallium scan $\times$ age}: a scan defect read with age
rows.usual: raises risk for some patients, lowers it for others

rows.name: \textbf{Other (one network each)}: ST slope $\times$ age, chest pain, cholesterol, fasting sugar, sex, vessels $\times$ age

legend: raises risk for some patients, lowers it for others
